author: KEXP
description: 90s rock icon Bob Mould continues through his career with fierce passion and dedication. With host Kevin Cole, Mould delivers a performance of Sugar's 1992 hit "If I Can't Change Your Mind" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Bob Mould performs "If I Can't Change Your Mind" & more Live on KEXP
